name: Placement API
description: Search, compare and buy SEO link placements across 10 supplier marketplaces via one API or MCP, with independently measured domain authority, held quotes and server-side spend caps.

skills.name: Search placements
skills.description: Searches deduplicated link inventory from 10 supplier marketplaces by domain rating, price, niche, geo and language (search_placements, GET /v1/offers).

skills.name: Plan a link basket
skills.description: Turns a brief into a costed basket of placements held at the quoted price, with up to two alternatives per line (plan_links, POST /v1/quote).

skills.name: Compare domain offers
skills.description: Lists every way to buy one domain, cheapest first, with independently measured traffic and a verification verdict (compare_domain, GET /v1/sites/{domain}).

skills.name: Map competitor link gaps
skills.description: Returns the referring domains a target's competitors have and it lacks, priced and held (gap_map, POST /v1/targets/gap).

skills.name: Find keyword winners
skills.description: Reports who ranks for a keyword, who links to them, and which of those publishers the catalogue carries (keyword_winners, GET /v1/keywords/winners).

skills.name: Place and track orders
skills.description: Places an order against prepaid credits with an idempotency key and reports delivery state; only for keys issued with the ordering scope (place_order, POST /v1/orders).
